messages:
ana_product: Quick thread to lock cross-team commitments for Pilot Bakeoff w/ ClearGate. They want hard guarantees before signing: tenant isolation, customer KMS, and a predictable p95 for UI flows. Need runtime + infra + security to confirm scope + timelines.
evan_runtime: quick q - what's the target p95 and token envelope? helps decide fallback strategy.
nana_product: target p95 = 230ms for <200-token interactive traces. We'll provide an eval set for semantic fidelity checks. Fallback allowed but must preserve top-3 response overlap >= 0.9.
priya_infra: capacity reality: we can reserve 4 GPUs (2 steady, 2 burst) with a 21-day lead time. prewarm soak = 72h. prefer to know if customer wants VPC peering or shared-edge.
rachel_sec: security gating: customer-managed HSM required, attestation report, mTLS w/ client certs, and verified log-scrub (no key IDs or plaintext keys). Also need SIEM forwarding proof.
marc_eng: app integration plan: feature-flag rollout, 3% canary for 24h, automated rollback command. I'll add smoke tests + a `rollback.sh`.
evan_runtime: runtime commitments we can make for pilot: support fp16 + q4 quant variants. int8/q2 need more validation so mark as not-supported. routing/fallback will be latency-first: if p99 > 1200ms for 5m, route new requests to quantized model and preserve KV cache.
nana_product: acceptance criteria (draft): - latency: <=230ms p95 for <200-token traces under nominal load - isolation: tenant-dedicated compute OR VPC peering + segregated logs - keys: customer KMS/HSM + attestation - reliability: failover runbook with RTO <=5 minutes - quality: top-3 overlap >=0.9 vs baseline on eval set
priya_infra: loadtest ask: 48h steady at 1.25x expected traffic + 30m spike at 3x. We'll schedule after LOI/PO.
rachel_sec: gating checklist items I'll produce: HSM attestation template, mTLS test steps, CI log-scrub job, and snapshot-sanitization proof. ETA Wed.
emma_product: (oops) sorry meant ana_product: owners & near-term dates: evan_runtime -> compatibility matrix + routing config (Tue); priya_infra -> capacity hold + prewarm schedule (Wed); rachel_sec -> attestation checklist + gating doc (Wed); marc_eng -> smoke tests + rollback script (Thu); ana_product -> finalize pilot doc & send to ClearGate (Fri).
infra-bot: TASK-99888 created: "cleargate-pilot-onboard" and prewarm job tentatively scheduled for 2024-08-05 04:00 UTC :white_check_mark:
evan_runtime: draft routing snippet for review:
```
routing:
  policy: "latency"
  canary_fraction: 0.03
  fallback:
    trigger: "p99 > 1200ms for 5m"
    model: "cleargate-q4_0"
    preserve_kv_cache: true
  prewarm: true
```

rachel_sec: addendum - logging must be hashed or redacted at the ingress layer; CI must fail if sample logs contain key IDs.
evan_runtime: ack, we'll include a synthetic run and a log-scrub verification step in the runbook.
priya_infra: note on networking: if customer chooses VPC peering, prep time increases by ~3 days for peering setup. call this out in the final doc.
marc_eng: landing smoke tests today, will link PR and include a `rollback.sh` that flips feature flag + drains canary.
nana_product: reconvene Friday 9:30am PT to sign off on artifacts. if owners hit dates we can propose pilot start 2024-08-12 for a 2-week bakeoff. thanks everyone :rocket:
